findings.summary: build_features is called on the whole dataset before the train/test split, so scaling statistics include test rows and leak test data, inflating test AUC; fitted statistics are also never saved.

judge.reason: Identifies build_features called before split so test stats leak into scaling.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Mean and std are recomputed on every call rather than fit once and reused, so single-row inputs get NaN std (all numeric features NaN) and batches are scaled with their own statistics, shifting predictions between training and inference.

judge.reason: Describes train/serve skew and single-row NaN std, which are known other problems, not the leakage bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Zero-std (constant) columns produce 0/0 = NaN, which would make LogisticRegression.fit fail with 'Input contains NaN'; depends on the data, as no constant column was seen currently.

judge.reason: Zero-variance column NaN is a known other problem, not the leakage.

findings.label: valid_other
